name: PixelTransition-TS-TW
title: Pixel Dissolve Transition
description: A photo card breaks into a grid of white squares on hover, settling into a dark panel of route details; leaving dissolves it back to the photo.
use: A card needs to hide selling details behind an image until the visitor shows interest.
avoid: Its second face is only revealed on hover, focus or tap, so it is easy to miss on a quiet page.
a11y: Focus and tap trigger the reveal and the inactive face is aria-hidden, but there is no visible focus ring and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white-bordered card showing a blue-green mountain valley, with a small caption below outside the frame. During the change a grid of white squares scatters over the face, uncovering white text on near-black beneath.
behaves: Hovering or focusing fires white pixels in random order across the card, swaps the photo for the trip panel at the peak, then clears the pixels. Leaving runs the same sequence in reverse.
customise: Both faces are content props, alongside grid size, pixel colour, step duration, one-shot mode, aspect ratio, className and style. Nothing inside the faces is editable.
weight: light: Up to 144 plain divs shown and hidden by one GSAP stagger; it only runs on hover.
